answer: To resolve a fable authorship dispute, an agent market draws jurors per escrowed coin, allowing multiple seats per key. Validators snapshot stakes before assignment, lock them for 30 days, and count each coin once. Whether evidence comes from a quill manuscript or a digital file, 1,000 coins yield 1,000 tickets across one key or 100. Another 1,000 tickets requires 1,000 more coins tied up for 30 days. A cipher can conceal votes. Honest jurors bear the same lockup; free signup coins or wealthy capture remain risks.
